name: Necromancer Game of Bones cuts the shared Champion cooldown to 2 minutes (#1798)
contract: Game of Bones 301198 is a Necromancer class-tree passive (CharacterAdvancement 29520, ClassType 25 = class 23, Tab 87 Class, AbilityEssenceCost 1) whose description reads 'Reduces the cooldown of your Champion spells by $/1000;s1 sec.' Its only effect is SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107) MiscValue 11 (SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN), EffectBasePoints -60001 + DieSides 1 = -60000 ms, EffectSpellClassMask (0, 0, 0x800000) in SpellFamilyName 29, which matches exactly the three Champion summons Gravebound 805049, Spellbound 807811 and Icebound 807813 (family flags 0, 0, 0x800000; Spell.dbc Category 55). Each Champion tooltip reads 'Shares a $?s301198[2min][3min] cooldown with other Champion spells', so the expectation is 3 minutes shared without the passive and 2 minutes shared with it. The Necromancer contract sets the Champions' RecoveryTime and CategoryRecoveryTime to 180000 ms; Player::AddSpellAndCategoryCooldowns applies SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN to both before starting the spell and category cooldowns, and the aura is not one of the family-29 aura 42/354 effects the contract turns into dummies, so no script is required. Two Necromancers each summon a Gravebound Champion once: the control must see about 180000 ms on it and on the Icebound Champion through the shared category, the one with Game of Bones about 120000 ms on both.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
The Game of Bones passive aura is applied
Game of Bones resolves to a 60 second reduction
CONTROL: no cooldown modifier without the passive
Game of Bones summons a Gravebound Champion
SETUP: the control's Champion buff is active
SETUP: the Game of Bones Champion buff is active
CONTROL: Gravebound Champion has a 3 minute cooldown
CONTROL: Icebound Champion shares the 3 minute cooldown
DISCRIMINATING: Game of Bones leaves a 2 minute Champion cooldown
Icebound Champion shares the 2 minute cooldown
